description: This file implements the USBMassStorage plugin for WPEFramework, including initialization, deinitialization, notification handling for device mount/unmount events, and plugin registration.

classes.name: USBMassStorage
classes.description: Main plugin class managing USB storage devices, handling initialization, notifications, and cleanup.

classes.name: USBMassStorage::Notification
classes.description: Nested class handling device mount and unmount notifications.

methods.name: USBMassStorage::USBMassStorage
methods.description: Constructor initializing member variables and logging startup.

methods.name: USBMassStorage::Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, sets up device interface, and registers for notifications.

methods.name: USBMassStorage::Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources, unregisters notifications, and terminates connections.

methods.name: USBMassStorage::Information
methods.description: Returns a string describing the plugin's purpose.

methods.name: USBMassStorage::Notification::Activated
methods.description: Handles activation of remote connections (empty implementation).

methods.name: USBMassStorage::Notification::OnDeviceMounted
methods.description: Handles device mounted events, constructs JSON payload, and notifies.

methods.name: USBMassStorage::Notification::OnDeviceUnmounted
